scientific_integrity: The infinite claim is proved symbolically. The computational artifact is only a regression check. The originality assessment explicitly records the inaccessible older source as a residual risk rather than treating failed access as evidence of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem excludes only hosts with at most two distinct prime factors. It does not settle the existence of a host with three or more prime factors, and therefore does not resolve whether (q+2)/q is an abundancy ratio for any odd prime q. An older highly relevant paper by Ryan could not be inspected in full.
title: Prime quasi-friendly divisors force at least three prime factors in the host
